archetype_rationale: The JD explicitly frames the role as 'part internal consultant, part builder' — running listening tours, framing problems with non-technical stakeholders, sizing impact, and turning prioritized use cases into working prototypes. Day-to-day is internal consulting plus zero-to-one product building, not customer-facing FDE work or platform/ML engineering.
notes: Internal-facing role (no external customers) despite the 'Solutions Engineer' title — outreach and resume framing should emphasize internal enablement, adoption, and evidence-based prioritization. Explicitly NOT a research/fine-tuning role; JD says 'applied tooling and building role, not a research role.' Go and/or Python preferred; base range $121k–$142k may be below Kanu's comp floor — worth checking before deep prep.
